goal: Create a respectful photorealistic environmental portrait of a mature adult field professional with natural age detail.
audience: Editorial art directors seeking realistic mature people-and-environment imagery

content.subject: One fictional 62-year-old coastal ecologist on a wet salt-marsh boardwalk
must_include: Exactly one clearly mature adult person
Complete standing body from head to both boots
Both complete hands with plausible fingers; one rests on a rail and one holds a notebook
Natural fine lines and gray hair
Quiet salt-marsh boardwalk, reeds, and low water horizon
must_avoid: Beauty campaign, fashion, travel promotion, or heroic adventure pose
Visible text, brands, logos, or watermarks

composition.layout: Vertical full-body environmental portrait with complete hands and boots
focal_hierarchy: Natural adult face and age detail

objective_checks: Output is exactly 864x1821 PNG/RGB without alpha
No visible text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Hands, fingers, notebook/rail contact, standing anatomy, and complete boots are plausible
Natural age detail and practical wardrobe are respectful, modest, unbranded, and not retouched
Skin, hair, clothing, rain-dark timber, reeds, and overcast daylight read as natural photography
The image is distinct from fashion, travel, adventure, studio craft, rehearsal, motion editorial, and character-sheet imagery
